Yes. Satellite data detected a **candidate tree-cover loss of 13.5 hectares in 2025**, about 3.9% of the property.

The finding is **pending corroboration**: 2025 is the latest year available, so a later observation is needed to assess whether the change persists. No loss event of 0.5 hectares or more was detected in 2021–2024.

The detection alone does not establish the cause, deforestation, legality or regulatory compliance.
